custom_fields.description: Highest priority commission override. When set for an Item, this rate is used instead of Item Group, Brand, or the general Commission Rate.
custom_fields.label: Item Commissions
custom_fields.name: Sales Person-custom_item_commissions

custom_fields.description: Commission override by Item Group. Used when no Item-level rate matches. Priority: Item → Item Group → Brand → Commission Rate.
custom_fields.label: Item Group Commissions
custom_fields.name: Sales Person-custom_item_group_commissions

custom_fields.description: Commission override by Brand. Used when no Item or Item Group rate matches. Priority: Item → Item Group → Brand → Commission Rate.
custom_fields.label: Brand Commissions
custom_fields.name: Sales Person-custom_brand_commissions
